Picks the [audio bus](Audio-Buses) that the sound of movies opened after it plays on. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
videos = CreateAudioBus()
MovieBus videos
intro = OpenMovie("intro.mp4")
AudioBusVolume videos, 0.8
```
@param bus  A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` (what movies start on) for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error.
@gap [ChannelBus](ChannelBus) on [MovieChannel](MovieChannel) moves the sound of one movie that is open already.
